objective: Verify nominal VehicleStatus transmission satisfies all acceptance criteria
preconditions: Test evaluator is configured for VehicleStatus CAN ID 0x180 with 10 required samples and 90-110 ms cycle limits
test_input: 10 valid VehicleStatus samples on CAN ID 0x180 with timestamps 0 100 200 300 400 500 600 700 800 900 ms
steps: Run qualification evaluation over the sample set
expected_result: Pass; detect 10 valid messages; calculate 9 intervals of 100 ms; no applicable check fails

objective: Verify VehicleStatus candidates using the expected CAN ID are identified correctly
preconditions: Test evaluator is configured for expected CAN ID 0x180
test_input: VehicleStatus candidate observed with CAN ID 0x180
expected_result: Identification passes and the candidate is recognized as a valid VehicleStatus sample

objective: Detect a VehicleStatus candidate observed with an incorrect CAN ID
preconditions: Test data identifies the candidate as VehicleStatus independently of the observed CAN ID
test_input: VehicleStatus candidate observed with CAN ID 0x181; expected CAN ID is 0x180
expected_result: Fail; wrong CAN ID is reported
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostic includes observed CAN ID 0x181 expected CAN ID 0x180 and failure reason

objective: Verify the minimum required number of valid samples is accepted
preconditions: Test evaluator is configured to require 10 valid samples
test_input: Exactly 10 valid VehicleStatus samples on CAN ID 0x180
expected_result: Sample presence/count check passes; observed valid sample count is 10

preconditions: Test evaluator is configured to require 10 valid samples
test_input: 8 valid VehicleStatus samples on CAN ID 0x180
expected_result: Fail due to insufficient valid samples
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostic includes observed sample count 8 required sample count 10 and failure reason

objective: Verify cycle-time calculation uses consecutive valid message timestamps
preconditions: At least two valid VehicleStatus messages are supplied
test_input: Two consecutive valid samples with timestamps 100 ms and 200 ms

objective: Verify the inclusive lower cycle-time limit
preconditions: Provide enough valid samples for qualification; every measured interval is within range except as specified
test_input: Valid samples with each consecutive interval equal to 90 ms
expected_result: Pass; 90 ms is accepted as the lower boundary

objective: Verify nominal cycle time is accepted
preconditions: Provide enough valid samples for qualification
test_input: Valid samples with each consecutive interval equal to 100 ms
expected_result: Pass; 100 ms is within the allowed range

objective: Verify the inclusive upper cycle-time limit
preconditions: Provide enough valid samples for qualification; every measured interval is within range except as specified
test_input: Valid samples with each consecutive interval equal to 110 ms
expected_result: Pass; 110 ms is accepted as the upper boundary

objective: Detect a cycle time just below the lower limit
preconditions: Provide at least two consecutive valid VehicleStatus samples
expected_result: Fail due to cycle time below allowed range
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostic includes measured cycle time 89 ms expected range 90-110 ms and failure reason

objective: Detect a cycle time just above the upper limit
preconditions: Provide at least two consecutive valid VehicleStatus samples
expected_result: Fail due to cycle time above allowed range
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostic includes measured cycle time 111 ms expected range 90-110 ms and failure reason

objective: Detect the specified short-cycle negative condition
preconditions: Provide at least two consecutive valid VehicleStatus samples
expected_result: Fail due to cycle time below allowed range
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostic includes measured cycle time 85 ms expected range 90-110 ms and failure reason

objective: Detect the specified long-cycle negative condition
preconditions: Provide at least two consecutive valid VehicleStatus samples
expected_result: Fail due to cycle time above allowed range
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostic includes measured cycle time 115 ms expected range 90-110 ms and failure reason

objective: Verify every measured cycle time is checked and a violation prevents PASS
preconditions: Provide at least 10 valid VehicleStatus samples with all but one interval inside range
test_input: Nine or more measured intervals with one interval outside 90-110 ms
expected_result: Fail even when other intervals pass

objective: Verify overall result aggregates PDU identification presence and timing checks
preconditions: Use one complete valid nominal dataset and separate datasets with one applicable requirement violated
test_input: Valid dataset: ID 0x180; at least 10 valid samples; all measured intervals 90-110 ms. Negative datasets: wrong ID or insufficient samples or out-of-range interval
steps: Run qualification evaluation for each dataset
expected_result: Valid dataset reports PASS; each dataset with an applicable failure reports FAIL
diagnostic_checks: Failure dataset identifies the applicable failing check

objective: Verify failure reports contain sufficient information to identify the failure
preconditions: Prepare wrong-ID insufficient-sample and out-of-range-cycle-time failure datasets
test_input: Wrong ID 0x181; 8 valid samples; and an interval of 85 ms in separate evaluations
steps: Run qualification evaluation for each failure dataset
diagnostic_checks: Diagnostics include applicable sample/message index timestamp observed and expected CAN IDs measured cycle time expected range and failure reason
